lot_dimensions.min_lot_width_note: ต้องการที่ดินกว้างอย่างน้อย = 12.20 ม. Top dimension chain (verified at 2x-3x zoom): 'A' (undimensioned setback, แนวเสา/setback-letter zone) | 7.00 bracket over grid1-grid3, sub-split 3.50+3.50 | 1.10 (grid3 to building's east edge) | 'A' (undimensioned setback) = 12.20 total. The 7.00 bracket (3.50+3.50) exactly matches the grid master's x_lines (1=0.00, 2=3.50, 3=7.00). The 1.10 segment beyond grid3 independently confirms the grid master's dummy grid 3' (pos_m 8.10 = 7.00+1.10) from a completely independent (architecture, not structural) sheet. If both 'A' zones are equal, 2xA = 12.20-7.00-1.10 = 4.10, i.e. A ≈ 2.05m each side — not independently printed as a number, inferred by subtraction only.
lot_dimensions.min_lot_depth_note: ต้องการที่ดินกว้างอย่างน้อย = 15.90 ม. (label reads 'กว้าง' even though this is the vertical/depth-axis chain — same wording ambiguity as sister houses' equivalent sheet; likely means 'ลึก' (depth), transcribed as printed rather than silently corrected). Left dimension chain (verified at 3x zoom), top to bottom: 'A' (undimensioned setback, no number, terminates right above gridE) | 10.70 bracket gridE-gridA, sub-split 3.00(E-D)+2.20(D-C)+4.00(C-B)+1.50(B-A), exactly matching the grid master's y_lines (E=0.00,D=3.00,C=5.20,B=9.20,A=10.70) | 2.05 (gridA to the south property line) | 'B' (a second, wider bracket spanning from gridA down to/through the same property-line point as the 2.05 tick — 'B' and '2.05' terminate at the same point in this house, unlike sister house #1 (บ้าน_เล็ก_2ชั้น_01) whose equivalent sheet showed a further distinct 0.95m segment beyond its own 2.05 leading to a second dummy grid A''; no such further segment is visible here). 15.90 - 10.70 - 2.05 = 3.15m computed (not printed) for the undimensioned north-of-E 'A' zone.
confidence_flags: GRID_MASTER_CORROBORATION: the 2.05m dimension from gridA to the south property line, read independently on this architecture sheet, exactly matches the grid master's dummy grid A' offset (10.70+2.05=12.75) — see warnings[] for full detail; this is a second, independent confirmation of a grid line the master itself flagged at reduced confidence (0.7) since it had only one structural source (S-04) referencing an unopened detail sheet.

min_lot_width/depth vertical-axis label wording ('กว้าง' vs likely-intended 'ลึก') read at medium confidence due to 90°-rotated small print, matching the same ambiguity flagged on sister houses' equivalent sheet
